modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: SalamAir's included hand baggage is one under-seat piece; a trolley bag for the cabin is a paid service.

personal_item.value: 1 piece under the seat in front, not exceeding 25cm x 33cm x 20cm, such as a small laptop bag, small plastic bag or small ladies' bag.

carryon_weight.value: The included hand baggage allowance is 5KGs.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: A cabin trolley bag needs the paid “Trolley Bag” service, which adds 10 kg for a trolley bag not exceeding 56cm x 45cm x 25cm.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Checked baggage depends on the allowance you book.

pieces_by_allowance.value: 1 piece if your booked allowance is 10kg, 20kg or 30kg; 2 pieces if it is 40kg.
